text_description: Full-length runway look centered on a model wearing an oversized, mid-thigh brown leather-like coat with a subtle sheen, structured volume through the body, dropped or broad shoulders, and long sleeves ending at the wrists; the coat is styled closed with a self-tie belt knotted at the front waist, with the belt ends hanging down asymmetrically, and the hands are tucked into side pockets, emphasizing a relaxed, enveloping silhouette. A large tawny brown fur-like shawl collar frames the neck and upper chest, spreading widely over the shoulders and upper front of the coat and adding heavy cold-weather texture against the smooth brown surface. Beneath the coat, dark tailored trousers are visible from the upper thigh down, cut straight to slightly loose with a long break over the shoes and patterned in a small black-and-gray check. At the feet, flashes of bright red footwear appear under the trouser hems, with dark toe/sole areas visible, giving a sharp color accent to the otherwise earthy palette. Styling is minimal and undone, with very long loose dark hair falling over the fur collar and down the front, creating a moody fall runway impression built around plush outerwear, belted leather shine, checked tailoring, and a red shoe contrast.
key_elements: bright red footwear glimpsed at hem
long loose dark hair over collar
earthy brown and dark palette with red accent
uncertainty_notes: Coat surface appears leather-like from sheen, but exact material is not confirmed.
Collar appears fur-like, but whether real or faux is not visible.
Footwear shape is partly obscured by the trouser hems.
